preservedResponsibilities: Original signed64 known-length SAL toInt and UTF16 o3tl::toInt32 retain exact original whitespace/sign/digit/first-invalid-stop/overflow-to-zero and default radix10. BigInt preserves original unsigned accumulation and signed64 limits; signed32 narrowing occurs only after the original range-to-zero guard. The original internal whitespace classifier remains in o3tl, the generic algorithm/signed64 specialization and internal sign/digit/DivMod owners remain in SAL, and real C/header/radix/SAL signed32 macro boundaries are shared once. Genuine whole original SAL/CPPU translation units and unchanged strtmpl/o3tl headers observe complete constants, quotient/remainder/positive guard, every65536 UTF16 whitespace/digit predicate for every2..36 radix, selected scalar contexts, all prefixes of full radix/boundary/control/sign inputs and default10 values. Complete normal/ASan/UBSan byte streams and nine original checked fatal assertions must agree. Original mutual SAL/o3tl inline-header directions are retained; no app/browser dependencies or duplicated whitespace owner. Checked C assertions map to Error, distinct from UNO exceptions. This specialization does not certify terminated/byte/unsigned/template overloads, original NDEBUG invalid-radix fallback, arbitrary out-of-contract JS numbers or storage, native ABI/thread lifetime, full original QA or unfinished getByName/UNO/case-service consumers. Broad capability parity/default/verification flags stay false.

filenameDivergence.rationale: Original include/rtl/string.h and include/rtl/string.hxx are distinct C declaration and C++ value-owner headers with the same normalized stem. Retaining the original .h discriminator before .ts gives the browser module loader distinct identities and preserves the original C radix-macro boundary. The C++ OString value-owner header remains unported; no alternate value owner is folded into this C export module.
